scripts.build: npm run build -w @colabdeck/shared && npm run build -w @colabdeck/webview && npm run build -w colabdeck && npm run sync:probe
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @colabdeck/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @colabdeck/shared && npm run test -w @colabdeck/shared && npm run test -w colabdeck && python3 -m pytest packages/probe -q
